readme:
# Vidu Q3 Image to Video

Vidu Q3 image-to-video: animate a first frame, optionally toward a last frame, into a 1–16 second clip with native audio.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 2,000 characters. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `end_image` | image URL | — | Optional last frame. |
| `audio` | boolean | true | Generate native audio. Same price on or off. |
| `resolution` | `360p` / `540p` / `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | integer 1–16 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds: $0.07 at 360p or 540p, $0.154 at 720p, $0.16 at 1080p.

| Output | 540p | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4s | $0.28 | $0.616 | $0.64 |
| 5s (default) | $0.35 | $0.77 | $0.80 |
| 8s | $0.56 | $1.232 | $1.28 |
| 16s | $1.12 | $2.464 | $2.56 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, camera, and sound.

## Also on SandBase

Other Vidu Q3 endpoints: `vidu/q3/text-to-video`, `vidu/q3/reference-to-video/mix`, `vidu/q3/text-to-video/turbo`, `vidu/q3/image-to-video/turbo`.
